paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Overall performance gap 0.90\% of LLMs between the two KGDS patterns. A larger gap indicates lower stability in cross-pattern performance.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the overall performance gap—measured as a percentage—between two knowledge-grounded discussion summarization (KGDS) patterns for various large language models (LLMs), with a reported average gap of 0.90% across models; a larger gap signifies lower stability in cross-pattern performance. The vertical y-axis represents the “Performance Gap (%)” and ranges from 0 to 30, with major tick marks at intervals of 5. The horizontal x-axis lists eight distinct LLMs, each represented by a uniquely colored bar, though the model names are not labeled directly on the axis. The bars, arranged left to right, display the following approximate performance gaps: 15.15% (teal), 25.66% (purple), 9.60% (light blue), 11.37% (pink), 28.29% (light blue-gray), 18.80% (beige), 21.88% (light lavender), 23.79% (light gray), 17.27% (tan), 22.41% (light gray-green), 23.47% (off-white), and 24.01% (light pink). The bars are not sorted by value, and no explicit grouping or stacking is present; each bar stands independently. The tallest bar corresponds to 28.29%, while the shortest is 9.60%, indicating variability in cross-pattern stability across the evaluated models. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, or annotations beyond their numerical labels displayed above each bar.
